description: IRS Table 2010CM: survivors l_x out of 100,000 births at each age 0 to 110 (unisex); the fallback mortality table while no SSA period life table is installed
provenance: re-extracted on 2026-11-13 from table-2010cm-final.xlsx; the CSV reproduces the SHA-256 pinned by seams §8 D3 byte for byte
label: irs_2010cm_fallback (unisex; sex has no effect while this table is used; runs carry the warning mortality_fallback_table)

sources.title: IRS Table 2010CM (table-2010cm-final.xlsx)
sources.section: Sheet1, the three column pairs (Age x, l_x) in columns B:C, F:G and J:K
sources.note: Equal to the pinned SHA-256. Table 2010CM is the mortality table of the section 7520 regulations (Publication 1457); that description is from the IRS actuarial-tables page as summarized during design, not re-read here.

extraction.format: %d,%.5f; header age,lx; LF line endings; trailing newline

derived: The engine derives q[x] = 1 - lx[x+1] / lx[x] for x = 0..108 and sets q[109] = 1 (lx[110] = 0).
